title: Canada Opens The Floodgates
summary:
Trans Mountain Expansion will change Pacific Aframax market
The expansion of the Trans Mountain Pipeline (TMX) is almost complete. Trans Mountain has started to fill sections of the pipeline with oil and sometime in May, the first export cargo will be loaded. It is reportedly a shipment of heavy crude that is going to China.
